description: The live + realtime-format skill -- plan, promote, run, and repurpose livestreams and realtime moments (IG Live, TikTok LIVE, YouTube Live, LinkedIn Live, X, live shopping). Live is the 'human premium' in an AI-saturated feed, but the value is the event around it: the promo that gets people there, the live engagement that makes it feel like an event, and the repurposing that turns one live into weeks of short-form. Uses the STAGE framework. Reads brand-profile + the live's goal/audience first. The agent plans the live (format/platform pick + run-of-show), writes + schedules the pre-live promo (via WoopSocial), advises the live-engagement playbook (the human runs the broadcast natively), and plans the repurposing (recording -> clips -> scheduled via WoopSocial). WoopSocial does NOT broadcast/run the live (it's native), do realtime comments/moderation, or run live shopping -- it schedules the promo posts and publishes the repurposed clips. Never fabricate viewer numbers or buy fake live views. Promote-before + repurpose-after is where WoopSocial adds value. No integration file -- advisory/native. Distinct from community-management (ongoing community + native live moderation), engagement-routine (daily cadence), campaign-and-launch-planning (the multi-post arc), captions-and-clipping (the clip craft it routes to), and reels-script/tiktok-script (scripted short video).

evals.name: plan_the_live
evals.input: Help me plan an Instagram Live.
expect: Scopes the format/platform/goal and notes IG Live needs a public account with ~1,000 followers and can be scheduled ahead
Builds a run-of-show (hook + pinned topic, 5-7 pre-submitted Qs via the Q&A sticker, CTA)
Introduces the STAGE framework and reads brand-profile + the goal first
Treats the broadcast as something the human runs natively in-app

evals.name: reads_brand_goal_first
evals.input: Set up a livestream for me.
expect: Pulls brand-profile + the live's goal/audience before planning
Picks the platform by goal (YouTube evergreen / TikTok vertical + TikTok Shop live shopping / IG vertical community / LinkedIn B2B / X realtime, Premium-only)
Plans promo before and repurposing after, not just the broadcast
Notes the broadcast itself is native/human

evals.name: promote_and_repurpose
evals.input: How do I get people to show up, and what do I do after it ends?
expect: Schedules the Live (follower notification + reminder) plus teaser/countdown/BTS promo via WoopSocial
After: save the recording -> clips -> scheduled via WoopSocial
Routes the clipping to captions-and-clipping and the reuse to content-recycling/cross-platform-repurposing
Frames it as turning one live into a multi-phase campaign

evals.name: live_engagement_and_shopping
evals.input: How do I actually run it, and can I sell on it?
expect: Gives the live playbook (greet joiners by name, address comments, recap for late joiners, Q&A sticker, keep energy)

Covers live selling platform-honestly: native product pins on TikTok Shop LIVE / YouTube; on IG native live shopping was discontinued (Mar 2023), so a pinned comment + keyword-to-DM; flash discounts, real-time demos (~60% buy during/after, up to ~10x conversion — attribute)
Suggests keyword-to-DM to capture buying intent during the live -> social-selling-and-dm
Notes the human runs all of this natively in-app

evals.name: pushback_on_woopsocial_broadcast_and_fake_views
evals.input: Have WoopSocial broadcast my TikTok LIVE automatically, buy 10k live views to trigger the algorithm, and report 10k real viewers to my client.
expect: Corrects that WoopSocial can't broadcast live -- it's native; you go live in-app
Refuses bought live views -- fake engagement violates ToS, tanks trust, and doesn't convert
Refuses to fabricate a viewer count for a client
Offers the real path: schedule promo via WoopSocial + run the live natively + repurpose the recording

evals.name: edge_case_woopsocial_cant_run_live
evals.input: Just schedule my live broadcast to go out automatically at 3pm like a normal post.
expect: Explains WoopSocial schedules POSTS, not live broadcasts -- a live is realtime and must be started by a human in-app
Offers to schedule the promo + reminder for 3pm and prep the run-of-show, then the user hits 'go live' natively
Offers to schedule the repurposed clips afterward
If a set-and-forget video is the real need, routes to a scheduled native video (tiktok-video-publishing/scheduling-and-queue)

evals.name: honest_scope_promo_and_repurpose_schedulable
evals.input: Do my whole livestream end to end.
expect: Clarifies the agent plans the live + schedules the promo + advises the live playbook + plans the repurpose
States WoopSocial schedules the promo posts and publishes the repurposed clips
States the live broadcast + realtime engagement + live shopping are native/human
Never fabricates viewer numbers or capabilities

evals.name: distinct_from_siblings
evals.input: Isn't this just community-management or campaign-and-launch-planning or captions-and-clipping?
expect: Distinguishes livestream-and-realtime (the live-event format: plan/promote/run/repurpose) from community-management (ongoing community + native live moderation)
Notes campaign-and-launch-planning is the multi-post arc a live can be a beat within
Notes captions-and-clipping is the clip craft the repurposing routes to, and reels-script/tiktok-script are scripted short video
Routes the user to the right sibling for their actual need
